scope: Browser fixtures plus a read-only public API check; no production score submissions

results.name: Homepage does not request scores or load Unity before interaction
Public API renders its actual response without fixture scores
Loading contains no invented scores and disables duplicate refreshes
Ten scores stay visible across desktop and mobile layouts
Empty and partial boards leave unclaimed positions without fake entries
Initial HTTP failure recovers through the retry button
Refresh failure explicitly marks the retained last successful scores
Network failure and malformed API responses never create fallback scores
Slow requests time out and cannot overwrite a newer successful retry
Player names stay text and signed 32-bit scores fit narrow screens
No-JavaScript users get an explanation and working navigation
